column1: # Glow in the dark, round 2 (Plants, notes/NIGHT_GLOW.md): foxfire and goblins_gold are flat mats (16x1x16) seen from above, only the threads and flecks glow (_e from emissive.py). The mushroom redraw stays out of the game: the approved glow_mycena keeps its look. column3: foxfire|cube|Foxfire on a damp forest floor, seen from straight above, seamless: dark rotting twigs, bits of soft decayed wood and dark brown leaf litter (#1e1a16 #2c261f #3c3329 #4e4335 #5e5040), crossed by a fine network of thin pale whitish threads of fungus mycelium with a cool blue-green tint (#9cc8bc #bfe4d8 #dcf4ec), the threads one pixel wide, branching and running along and under the twigs in lines and small flecks, covering about a sixth of the square, light from the top left
column4: goblins_gold|cube|Goblin's gold moss on cave stone, seen from straight above, seamless: a low velvety carpet of very fine dark green moss (#1e2a1a #2a3a22 #364a2a #44582f) covering the square, a little sage-grey stone (#4e5250 #707570) showing through in two or three small gaps, scattered with small bright gold-green flecks (#a8b83a #c8d44c #e4e872) like tiny glinting cells, one or two pixels each, about one fleck per 20 pixels, light from the top left
column5: mycena_redraw@-|plant|Glowing bonnet mushrooms (Mycena): a cluster of four or five tiny mushrooms, 8-12 px tall, on thin pale stems standing at different heights from a small crumb of dark wood at the bottom, the small bell-shaped caps pale cream with a yellow-green tint (#8a9468 #b4c47c #d4e49c #ecf6c4), the gills under the caps pale yellow-green, stems pale grey (#8a8c80 #b4b6a8), dark outline in a deep shade of its own colour, the same look as the third reference image's mushrooms but smaller, light from the top left
